diagnose.title: Disease diagnosis
diagnose.noKeyHint: To diagnose plants, add a free Gemini API key in settings.
diagnose.photoPrompt: Take a photo of the sick plant
diagnose.how1: Photograph the problem area (sick leaf, stem, roots)
diagnose.how2: Close up, sharp, in good light
diagnose.how3: Also photograph the underside of the leaf if you see something worrying there
diagnose.how4: The AI suggests a diagnosis — for serious problems it won't replace an expert

light.title: Light meter
light.intro: Point the camera at the spot where you want to put a plant. The app measures the brightness and suggests which species will do well there.
light.how1: Point the phone towards the spot where the plant will stand
light.how3: Don't point it straight at the sun — it skews the reading and can damage the camera
light.how4: The reading is approximate — the camera adjusts exposure by itself
light.veryLowRec: Only the most shade-tolerant — snake plant, ZZ plant, pothos.
light.lowRec: Plants that tolerate low light — peace lily, philodendron, ferns.
light.mediumRec: Ideal for most houseplants — monstera, calathea, dracaena.
light.highRec: Great for light-loving plants — ficus, banana plant, cacti in partial shade.
light.sunRec: For succulents, cacti and herbs — aloe, lavender, basil, rosemary.
